day_1.question: Q1 (Physics). A solid sphere is rolling without slipping on a rough horizontal surface. It collides elastically with a smooth vertical wall. After the collision, the friction force on the sphere will act in:
day_1.hint: Collision is smooth, so only linear velocity reverses. Angular velocity remains the same. To establish pure rolling again, v = ωR must be achieved. Friction will act to decrease ω and increase v in the new direction.

day_1.question: Q2 (Math). If the roots of the equation x³ - 12x² + 39x - 28 = 0 are in A.P., then their common difference is:
day_1.hint: Let roots be a-d, a, a+d. Sum of roots = 3a = 12 => a = 4. Product of roots = a(a² - d²) = 28.

day_1.question: Q3 (Chem). Which of the following resonating structures of 1-methoxy-1,3-butadiene is least stable?
day_1.hint: Look for charge separation and incomplete octets. A positive charge on carbon adjacent to an electron-withdrawing or less stable position increases instability.

day_2.question: Q1 (Physics). In a YDSE setup, if the source is shifted upwards by a distance 'y', the central maxima will:
day_2.hint: Path difference must be zero at the central maxima. If the source moves up, the lower slit path becomes shorter before the slits, so it must travel further after the slits to compensate.
